predict.question: Equal groups have expected rates 90% and 10%. What is their aggregate?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Aggregate outcomes can conceal differences in how success is distributed.
modelBoundary: Both mixtures give {A}% and {B}%. One separates high and low expected rates; the other gives both groups the aggregate rate.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Rates are stipulated, not observed streaks. Equal averages establish neither equal randomness nor equal skill or individual outcomes.
